adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined with computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. In a JS object literal these expressions are evaluated immediately, and `z.string()` returns an object whose `.toString()` will produce the same string (typically `"[object Object]"`) in both cases, so the latter entry overwrites the former. This makes the intended "any numeric expiry field" constraint ineffective, and under the branch `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT)` the code uses this weakened schema (`minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)`), meaning it will accept essentially any response containing an `access_token` string while no longer validating expiry/shape as intended.
